Fantastic experience at this lodge. We spent three nights here, and all the staff were wonderful. We were especially impressed by the outstanding service provided by Ibra and Emmanuel. The whole team is incredibly friendly and always greets you with a smile. The setting is beautiful, the rooms are very comfortable, and the food is excellent. A wonderful experience from start to finish.

Posted on Tripadvisor
Raúl S
Verified Wonderful experience!!
I recently stayed at a lodge in Serengeti National Park and had a wonderful experience. The location was stunning, surrounded by wildlife and breathtaking landscapes. The staff were friendly and attentive, special remark for Ibra, making sure everything was comfortable throughout the stay. The rooms were clean, cozy, and well-designed to blend with nature. It was the perfect place to relax after a day of safari. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an authentic and peaceful Serengeti experience.
Posted on Tripadvisor
Marloes V
Verified In 1 woord: prachtig!
Geweldige ervaring, midden in de natuur! Met de geluiden van alle prachtige dieren om ons heen!
Posted on Tripadvisor
Adriana T
Verified Muy recomendable
Excelente atención especialmente Emmanuel que fue muy amable y atencioso
Posted on Tripadvisor
Andrea T
Verified Ottima camp nel Serengeti
Bellissimo camp nel Serengeti, struttura dotata di tutti i comfort. La cortesia e la simpatia dello staff sono un valore aggiunto
Posted on Tripadvisor
Léa Grappe
Verified Un super séjour
Un séjour mémorable ! On a passé 3 nuits dans le lodge Sound of Nature, les chambres sont magnifiques, la nourriture est très bonne et nous avons pu voir plusieurs animaux au coin du feu le soir, des impalas, des lapins, des hippopotames, ...
Posted on Tripadvisor
Daphnée B
Verified Mieux que le Sound Of Nature, il n’y a pas!
C’est de loin le plus beau lodge du Serengeti !! On est accueilli de la meilleure des façons et les employés sont tous très gentils et à notre disposition. Les animaux sauvages passent presque des chambres et la nuit nous sommes « escortés » par des employés Maasaï car les animaux peuvent être tout près! L’ambiance est excellente et les lodge sont magnifiques! Venez sans réfléchir! Le Sound Of Nature est LA destination a choisir si vous venez dans le Serengeti!
Posted on Tripadvisor
Danita Lop
Verified 100% recomendable
El lugar es un paraíso, en el medio de serengeti y con una experiencia impecable desde el inicio hasta el final. El lugar es hermoso y el staff es muy tengo, con detalles hermosos.

Unveiling the Essence of Luxury and Nature
Serengeti Sound of Nature Luxury Tented Camp is a premier safari Accommodation located in the heart of the iconic Serengeti National Park. Embracing the essence of African wilderness and offering a seamless blend of authenticity and luxury, our camp promises an unparalleled experience that immerses guests in the wonders of nature.
